_note: PROPOSED SCHEMA ONLY – not a real combined dataset. Each planetary body uses different datums, measurement methods, and instruments. Direct numerical comparison without careful normalisation is not scientifically valid.

proposed_fields.caution: Different datums: WGS84 (Earth), areoid (Mars), lunar mean radius (Moon)
Resolution differences affect measured slope values
Window size and resolution affect comparability
Very different measurement methods: MODIS IR (Earth) vs TES/MCS (Mars) vs Diviner (Moon). NOT directly comparable.

comparability_matrix.elevation_m: NOT directly comparable (different datums) – useful for relative terrain analysis only
comparability_matrix.slope_deg: COMPARABLE if spatial resolution differences are accounted for
comparability_matrix.lst_kelvin: NOT directly comparable – different sensor physics and atmospheric effects
comparability_matrix.land_cover: Earth-only concept – no direct analogue on Mars/Moon
